title: The Little Mushroom House: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: The mushroom house had a big red roof.
Mimi was wearing a purple apron.
The magic flower rings when someone in the forest needs help.
Rosie and Mimi found a baby hedgehog under a big rock.
That evening, Mimi made lemon tea.
What came from the chimney every morning?
items.why: “Every morning, sweet smoke curled from its chimney.”
“There was a small kitchen, a round table, and a cupboard full of colorful cups.”

items.q: Where was the magic flower growing?
items.why: “Mimi showed Rosie a little golden flower growing in a blue pot.”

items.q: Where was the baby hedgehog's home?
items.why: “The three friends walked through the forest until they reached a cozy nest beneath an old tree.”

items.q: What did Rosie share in the evening?
items.why: “Mimi made hot chocolate, and Rosie shared some honey biscuits.”

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: Rosie the rabbit found a little mushroom house where a mouse called Mimi lived. Mimi had a magic flower that rang when someone needed help. They followed its lights and helped a lost baby hedgehog find his way home.

items.q: What is special about Mimi's flower?
items.model: It is a magic flower. It rings like a tiny bell when someone in the forest needs help, and its petals can glow.

items.q: How did they help the baby hedgehog get home?
items.model: Mimi held up her magic flower. Little golden lights floated into the air, and they followed the lights to the hedgehog's nest.

items.q: What makes the mushroom house special, says Mimi?
items.model: The friends who come through its door.

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
items: Rosie heard a sound coming from the mushroom house
Rosie knocked on the tiny blue door
The magic flower began to ring
They found a baby hedgehog under a big leaf
The baby hedgehog found his mother
